summary.text: Micah Caskey is a Republican state representative from Lexington County who has represented South Carolina House District 89 since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

The House member page describes him as an attorney and businessman and lists him as chairman of the House Rules Committee; according to Ballotpedia, he faces Democrat Joe Madge in the general election, as the June 9 primaries were canceled.

paragraphs.text: Micah Caskey was born on June 2, 1981, in Columbia and earned a B.A. from the University of Florida in 2003, a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 2011 and an MBA from the University of South Carolina in 2012, according to the House member page.
The page lists his service as a captain in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2003 to 2013 and as an assistant solicitor in the 11th Judicial Circuit from 2014 to 2016.
Caskey has served in the South Carolina House of Representatives since 2017 and chaired the House Freshman Caucus in 2017-18, according to the House member page.
The page lists his committee assignments as Rules, which he chairs, and Ways and Means.
Ballotpedia reports that he defeated Melanie Shull in the 2022 Republican primary by 1,530 votes to 1,505 and defeated Democrat Wayne Borders in the 2024 general election.
